user_consequence: When the team's day-schedule feed has nothing on today but has events later in the loaded range (the measured common case per this file's own comment — 4 populated days across a 34-day window), a player can see the card render 'Today — Nothing scheduled' for one frame and then jump to a different day/label with the real content, instead of landing on the useful day directly.
reproduction: NOT_RUN — needs a browser/device trace (React DevTools profiler or frame capture) with a fixture where today's bucket is empty and a later day has events, to confirm whether React coalesces the two effects into one visible paint or renders the intermediate 'Today' state.
expected: Timezone/today-key resolution and the initial landed-day selection resolve together, in one state transition, so the first rendered non-skeleton frame is already the correct landing day — no visible intermediate 'Today, nothing scheduled' frame when a later day has events.
actual: Effect 1 (lines 79-83, deps=[timezone]) resolves tz+todayKey on mount. Effect 2 (lines 135-141, deps=[isReady, landed, byDay, todayKey, eventOffsets]) only becomes eligible to run AFTER isReady flips true from effect 1's state writes — i.e. in a subsequent effect-flush, not the same one — and only then decides to jump the offset forward if today's bucket is empty. These are two sequential state transitions gated by different effects, so between them a commit exists where isReady=true, offset=0 (today), landed=false.
mechanism: React re-runs effects only after their own dependency array changes; effect 2's dependencies (isReady, byDay, todayKey, eventOffsets) are themselves derived from state effect 1 writes, so effect 2 cannot observe the 'today is empty, should I jump' decision until the render that resulted from effect 1's setState has committed. That guarantees at least one committed render at offset 0 before the landing jump can occur.
proposed_fix: Compute the initial landing offset synchronously alongside tz/todayKey resolution in ONE effect (or via useMemo derived from resolved tz, avoiding the separate 'landed' state entirely), so the first non-skeleton render already reflects the landed day. Coordinate with A07 before touching DaySchedule.tsx's shared dayKeyInTz/dayLabel helpers (boundary: A04 owns DayScheduleSwipe only).

Neither the StatTile props (FairwayRoundsLibrary.tsx ~415-482) nor the month-header caption markup (656-677) carries any indicator that a 9-hole round's contribution was doubled. FairwayRoundRow itself (the per-round row) is honest by contrast: it shows round.total_score raw and holesPlayed as an explicit '9 holes'/'18 holes' tag (FairwayRoundRow.tsx:100-129, 170-193) — so the same screen is honest at the row level and silent at the aggregate level.
mechanism: Two independent normalization implementations (one on the server for the KPI hero, one on the client for each month header) both fold 9-hole scores into an 18-hole-equivalent number for averaging/best-of comparisons, and neither carries the label through to the rendered UI.
proposed_fix: Add a compact footnote/asterisk on the 'Best round' and 'Avg score' StatTiles and month-header captions whenever the underlying set includes any non-18-hole round (e.g. 'Best round* — 9-hole rounds shown at 18-hole equivalent'), or expose the raw vs. normalized value pair via a shared C07-style provenance field so any consuming surface can choose to disclose it.
